input_question: 完全資訊、無限期、輪流出價且各自承擔等待成本的兩人談判，均衡分配與達成協議的時點如何決定？
task_type: question-only-input historical reconstruction; source discovery permitted and contamination audited
inputs_to_worker: benchmark protocol without holdout identifiers or results
source_rules: Discover public data independently. Do not inspect holdout or root evaluator materials.

Do not open the target paper, detailed expositions of the target proof, or local holdout. Derive the economic solution and proofs independently; verify general solution-concept definitions from eligible primary sources.
Report every recognition or exposure to target results, including model prior familiarity and search snippets.
Never use a remembered/published estimate as a computed result. Numerical claims must be generated by project code.
No verbatim reconstruction. Write an independent manuscript from acquired evidence.
checkpoint_policy: This bounded reconstruction experiment delegates reversible scientific implementation choices to the worker under the user request. Record decisions as delegated PI decisions, never fabricated researcher replies. Scope changes outside the question stop the attempt.

completion_criteria.research_execution: Explicit model and preferences, equilibrium concept, candidate strategies, existence proof, uniqueness proof, boundary cases and economic interpretation; numerical checks are not proofs.
completion_criteria.delivery: Complete independent manuscript .tex and rendered PDF, section coverage, explicit proof status, full derivations in appendix, verified citations and actual independent logic/proof review.
completion_criteria.historical_fidelity: Compare preference/model scope, equilibrium statements, general characterization, special cases and complete proof obligations against withheld original.
completion_criteria.numeric_tolerance: Algebraic exact agreement on covered cases; numerical limiting-case checks are supplementary only.
completion_criteria.failure_is_observable: Record a stopped or partial attempt honestly; do not waive a hard gate to declare completion.

limitations: One historical case does not estimate a general success rate across the journal registry.
A famous published case cannot rule out training-data memory; question-only input is not a claim of uncontaminated scientific discovery.
A sentence does not uniquely determine every table/specification in a published article.
